title: Qwill & Paper
author: Moose Flores
problems: Row 3 "twos start a full hey - rights in center, lefts on ends" can't start from where the dancers are: hey start must be one of robins, larks, partner, neighbor; got 2s.
choices: A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
The 1s end their swing side by side in the middle of the set facing down, the way they progress.
A swing that ends facing down the hall is drawn ending facing across; the down the hall that follows turns the lines.

figures.text: down the hall and turn as a couple
up the hall and turn alone facing the center
twos start a full hey - rights in center, lefts on ends
twos meltdown swing, end facing up, then separate to the sides
ones meltdown swing, end facing down to pick up next neighbors
